p: Arachne is the platform-agnostic successor to the Lariat aligner for barcoded linked reads, which was originally written for the 10X Genomics GEMcode platform and included in the LongRanger software suite to use with a bespoke FASTQ-adjacent data format.

Lariat was designed to align all reads sharing the same barcode simultaneously, assuming that those reads came from the same molecule. This approach results in reads mapping better in repetitive regions of the genome.
From the root of the repo:

TL;DR: The only distinction between the 'standard' linked-read FASTQ files and regular FASTQ files is the presence of the BX:Z and VX:i SAM tags. The format also uses /1 and /2 (the older CASAVA format) to denote a forward/reverse read.
